title: Hilbert states describe finite ensembles of trajectories with rational amplitudes

statements.text: A complex Hilbert state describes a finite ensemble of trajectories on $I_U$, and is allowed only when its squared amplitudes are rational and its phase angles are rational multiples of $2\pi$. The number-theoretic incommensurateness of rational angles and their cosines accounts for complementarity.

sources.quote: but only if their squared amplitudes are rational and corresponding complex phase angles are rational multiples of $2 π$
